free_tier.stated: Free account exists; the current comparison table lists 2048 Mb maximum upload, unlimited download volume, 'Very Limited' download speed and files deleted 10 days after the last download. Premium removes the wait, ads and captcha: 'No Waiting | No Ads | No Captcha | Fast Download'.
free_tier.notes: The free tier's real download allowance was not published on the page read.

per_object_cap.stated: 10240 Mb premium and registered, 2048 Mb free

retention.stated: Premium: 60 days after last download. Registered: 30 days after last download. Free: 10 days after last download.

egress.terms: The current comparison table lists 'Unlimited' download volume on premium, registered and free tiers, and maximum download speed on premium against limited speed on registered and very limited on free. Premium removes waiting, ads and captcha.

interface_detail: Web upload and link checker. No API or FTP on the page read.
tooling: Browser only as read; the site is on the Leechall generator list. Clicknupload also runs an affiliate programme ('Make Money'), so many links in the wild are placed to earn rather than shared.
chaining: The cheapest paid month of the file hosts swept at $15, with a $50 year. Because free traffic is already unlimited per day, the $15 buys time rather than bytes - which is the only case in tested services where a host's paid tier is worth it for a small pull.

limits.value: free downloads carry a wait and a captcha per file; premium removes both
unstated: the account bar's traffic field renders as empty template text

limits_note: Neither the free nor the paid transfer ceiling is published. The only quantified thing on the page is the price.
binding_note: With no published byte ceiling, the wait and captcha on the free tier is the only constraint that can be named from the evidence. $15 removes it; what remains unknown is whether a byte cap appears behind it.

identity_cost.detail: Payment options on the premium page: Visa/MasterCard, Way2Bill, PayPal, Bitcoin, Litecoin, USDT (TRC20), ETH. A premium key can also be bought from resellers for the same four prices.

reliability_note: The site states 'Different fees are applied by payment providers', so the listed $15 is not what a card is charged; the reseller key route avoids the processor fee and adds a reseller's margin.
confidence_note: Prices and payment methods read on the vendor premium page today. The free tier's allowance, speed and per-file cap are all unpublished, so the 'unlimited' text in the account bar is recorded as template, not evidence.

evidence.proved: the four prices ($15 30 days, $25 90 days, $40 180 days, $50 365 days), the identical reseller key prices, 'No Waiting | No Ads | No Captcha | Fast Download', and the payment list including USDT TRC20, Litecoin and ETH
the site now serves from clicknupload.click; .org redirects to the .click login page, which is why the record cites .click
the free tier now publishes a 2048 Mb upload cap, unlimited download volume and 10-day lifetime
